evals.prompt: I'm writing a new service in apps/server-nestjs. Which authoring skill applies?
evals.expected_output: sks-ts-authoring (TypeScript). Match: .ts/.tsx under apps/ shared package.

evals.prompt: I'm adding a devshell and a module option to shikanime-labs/machines. Which authoring skill applies?
evals.expected_output: sks-nix-authoring (Nix). Match: .nix in a flake / module.

evals.prompt: A .nix module emits YAML via sopsFile. Does it also need the manifests skill for the generated file?
evals.expected_output: No double-apply. The .nix is sks-nix-authoring; the generated YAML surface is sks-kubernetes-manifests-authoring, but they are different files — the Nix side is Nix-only.
